title: ethereum/go-ethereum v1.9.6: Elasa (v1.9.6)
summary:
Geth v1.9.6 is a bug fix release, which improves light client sync to not start from zero when a CHT checkpoint is available (#20120).
This release also adds support for EIP-1898: all state-related RPC methods now support specifying block hashes as well as block numbers. This affects ethgetBalance,
